# Fixtures for `cd_bin` (Raw CD image)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0. The volumes hold a fictitious harbour's tide table (Saltmere Harbour); keys and passphrases were made for the run and are not secrets. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/disks.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `saltmere-mode1.bin` | craft_disks.py cdbin: `iso9660/saltmere-rockridge.iso` in 2352-byte mode 1 sectors (sync, address, EDC; ECC left zero) | CC0-1.0 |
| `saltmere-mode2.bin` | craft_disks.py cdbin: the same in mode 2 form 1 sectors | CC0-1.0 |
